notes.notes:
New Halloween Level has been added for testing. 
More features to be added in the next few days.

notes.title: New Levels, New Achievements, Possibly new glitches....
notes.notes:
Classic Zombie Snowmen now included. 
2 Player Duck Hunters
New Achievements for Halloween and Western levels. 

*There are some glitches I have noticed. 
On the Quest 2 with Oculus Link the game sometime flickers, I turned the headset off and on and it seemed to fix it. 
Also on 2 occasions the pumpkins on the Broomstick failed to load/display. Let me know if either of these happen to you.

notes.title: June Update - New Levels and Modes
notes.notes:
Hi All, 
I know it's been a LONG time*, I have been working really hard recently to bring you new content, new levels, new playing modes and old concept level aka - deleted scenes. 

Coming in an update very soon, my old near legendary Attack of the Zombie Snowmen and reboot of an abandoned game i made a few years ago, but this time it is 2 player, one on PC other in VR. 

Watch this space. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35317593/2c925a210fef1d0eacde2ec9ae4fcc538a112e33.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35317593/94fdd5158dd5440445a80d0de58e03144d9a620d.jpg[/img]


*Unfortunately My day job through lock down has been busier than ever! Leaving me with no time for what i actually want to do :( ..but i feel fortunate that i have had job security through these difficult times.

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.notes:
Hi All, I know it's been a while... Changing the day job, lock down, working from home, loss of 'mojo' ...and now, my vive keeps refusing to work :/
But i am aiming to get new updates out in the next week! New levels, new features. 

Also question. I am going to have 2 options; Arcade mode, where you have instant access to around 9 levels and another mode, where you have to unlock levels through achievements, i.e. certain score targets etc. What can i call the other mode?

notes.title: New Winter Level
notes.notes:
A New level has been added. A short level - destroy the Snowmen, recover the gifts and free the penguins. 
More winter levels coming soon.

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Hi, 
I have now updated the game to include a flying broomstick level. There will be at least one more level before Halloween itself. 

You can control the speed by ducking your head closer to the handle or by letting to go. 

Enjoy.

notes.title: BroomStick Level Update
notes.notes:
Hi, 
I have updated the broom stick level. 
The speed of the projectile has been increased. 
A score board has been added.

Coming Soon - improved UI and second broomstick level.

notes.title: October Update - Fix and new level
notes.notes:
A new test level has been added, you can now fly through a scene on a broomstick. tilt your head closer to the broom to fly faster. Use you rapid fire wand to destroy the pumpkins. 
This level is still very much unfinished.

I received feedback from an Oculus user asking me to tilt the guns a little more down. This has now been done.
